page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5e.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6763P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. This virtual machine runs on the KVM hypervisor and provides 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage, featuring 15,358 GB of local SSD capacity. This high-capacity local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 80 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers and low-latency access to local disk volumes. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators.

Given the high ratio of local SSD storage to compute resources, the ecs.i5e.8xlarge offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large-scale local data caching or high-throughput disk operations without the overhead of network-attached storage. This hardware profile is suited for large relational databases, NoSQL data stores, distributed file systems, and data-intensive analytics pipelines.

This hardware profile delivers strong qualitative cost efficiency for applications requiring high-density local storage without relying on external network storage.
